_about: Accepted static analyzer findings. Compare is by file, checker and message shape, counted. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/analyzer-audit.py --write-baseline --log <transcript>` and read the diff: an entry that disappears means a finding was fixed, which is the only good reason for one to go.

_accepted_reasons.potential leak of an object: IOHIDManagerRef is held by an unmanaged property: clang reports @property (nonatomic) IOHIDManagerRef as 'assign ... unsafe_unretained', so ARC keeps no reference and the checker sees a store into a non-owning slot it cannot follow into another method. That was read out of the AST rather than assumed, because a strong property would turn the CFRelease below into an over-release. setupHidManager runs once, from an init that has no path returning nil, so the manager is never overwritten or orphaned, and both tearDownHidManager and dealloc unschedule it from the main run loop, close it, CFRelease it and set it to NULL.
_accepted_reasons.incorrect decrement of the reference cou: the same unmanaged-property blind spot on a CGColorRef: the setter retains the new colour before releasing the one it replaces and never releases NULL, so the balance the checker cannot see across methods is correct.
_accepted_reasons.converting a pointer value of type x to: every one of these is a nil test on an NSNumber pointer, which the retain-count checker reports because it reads any object pointer in a condition as a numeric conversion. The sites compare or test for nil, which is what they mean.
_accepted_reasons.null passed to a callee that requires a: VTDecompressionSessionCreate documents NULL for the encoder/decoder parameter as 'use the default', while the header marks the parameter nonnull, so passing NULL is the documented call and the annotation is the inaccurate one.
_accepted_reasons.user-facing text should use localized st: the string is localized, just not in a shape the checker follows: these sites build text through MLString and helpers that return the localized value, so the literal is an argument to a translation call rather than text shown untranslated.
_accepted_reasons.value stored to x: five shapes share this class and each was read. ControllerSupport's four level writes feed only a read inside #if TARGET_OS_IPHONE, which the macOS build compiles out of a function that is already a no-op without on-screen controls. HIDSupport+Scroll's highResolutionPath is a default that the branches at 261-290 recompute before the reads at 392 and 467. MouseCapture's bestOverflow is an argmax cursor whose final write only fed the comparison it lost, because the function returns bestEdge. Diagnostics' x is a left-to-right layout cursor advanced past the last control of the row, since the close button is right-aligned and the status label is pinned left. StreamViewController's weakRetryBind is read by the retry block at 1484, which runs after the assignment at 1490 -- after the point the analyzer's path stops following.
